title: SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
Job Summary 
 Within our SQL Server Database Administrator team at Kyndryl, you'll be a master of managing and administering the backbone of our technological infrastructure. You'll be the architect of the system, shaping the base definition, structure, and documentation to ensure the long-term success of our business operations. Your expertise will be crucial in configuring, installing and maintaining database management systems, ensuring that our systems are always running at peak performance. You'll also be responsible for managing user access, implementing the highest standards of security to protect our valuable data from unauthorized access. In addition, you'll be a disaster recovery guru, developing strong backup and recovery plans to ensure that our system is always protected in the event of a failure. Your technical acumen will be put to use, as you support end users and application developers in solving complex problems related to our database systems. You'll be a strategic partner, working closely with various teams to coordinate systematic database project plans that align with our organizational goals. Your contributions will not go unnoticed - you'll have the opportunity to propose and implement enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system, enabling us to deliver world-class services to our customers. 
 
 Who You Are 
 You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Shape the base definition, structure, and documentation of the database system to ensure the long-term success of business operations. Configure, install and maintain database management systems, ensuring systems run at peak performance. Manage user access and implement the highest standards of security to protect data from unauthorized access. Develop strong backup and recovery plans to ensure the system is protected in the event of a failure. Support end users and application developers in solving complex problems related to database systems. Coordinate systematic database project plans with various teams and propose and implement enhancements that improve performance and reliability. 
 
 Requirements 
 15+ years of hands-on experience as a SQL Server Database Administrator (depending on role level). Proven expertise in database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and migrations. Advanced knowledge of T-SQL, stored procedures, views, functions, and query optimization. Experience with backup, recovery, restoration, and disaster recovery planning. Hands-on experience with High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) technologies: Always On Availability Groups Failover Clustering Log Shipping Replication Database Mirroring. Strong database performance tuning and troubleshooting skills. Experience in monitoring database health, capacity planning, and resource utilization. Expertise in T-SQL scripting, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019/2022. Experience in handing SQL related Patching and lifecycle management. Experience with backup and recovery strategies. Experience with automation using PowerShell, SQL Agent Jobs, and scripting tools.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 The Enterprise Systems BI Data Analytics team owns the design, delivery and governance of YouGovs Power BI reporting and analytics estate, built on the Microsoft Fabric platform. Following an investment in internal capability, the team is building out its in-house engineering and development resource under the Enterprise Systems Senior Manager BI Data Analytics. As Senior Data Engineer, you will be an advanced-level professional responsible for the data pipelines, models and Fabric architecture that underpin the companys reporting and analytics. You will work autonomously on complex data engineering assignments, determine methods and procedures on new work, provide technical direction and mentoring to more junior engineers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design and implement scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Microsoft Fabric to deliver reliable, timely data for reporting. Build and maintain data warehouse, data lake and lakehouse architectures within the Fabric ecosystem, implementing OneLake integration patterns. Develop and optimise semantic models for performance and scalability, applying DAX and data-model best practices. Determine methods and procedures on new data engineering assignments, evaluating complex and variable factors to select the right approach. Leverage Fabric workloads (Data Factory, Synapse Data Engineering, Data Warehouse) and Spark notebooks for large-scale data processing. Configure and manage Fabric workspaces, security and governance, including row-level security and capacity monitoring and optimisation. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR) and enforce data standards and best practices across the platform. Provide technical guidance on data architecture decisions and develop models and procedures within the discipline. Mentor junior data engineers, reviewing work and building the teams internal capability. Work closely with BI developers to deliver robust reporting solutions that deliver value to the business. Document technical designs, processes and best practices so the platform is supportable and knowledge is retained in-house. 
 
 Technical Skills and Experience 
 Extensive experience in data engineering or related roles. Hands-on Power BI experience, including advanced DAX, Power Query (M), data modelling/star schema design, Power BI Service administration and Premium/Fabric capacity management. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, or comparable experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory or Databricks. Strong SQL skills and solid grounding in data warehousing and lakehouse architecture concepts. Programming experience in Python or PySpark, with proficiency in version control (Azure DevOps) and CI/CD practices. Experience with Azure cloud services (e.g. Data Lake Storage, Event Hubs, Stream Analytics) and data orchestration/workflow management. Microsoft certifications (DP-203, DP-600 or DP-700), or similar. 
 
 Behavioral Skills Competencies 
 Works autonomously, with authority over day-to-day priorities and the judgement to determine methods and approach on new assignments. Work is reviewed on completion against agreed outcomes rather than supervised in progress. (be accountable) Solves complex, non-routine problems by weighing variable factors and adapting established techniques, rather than applying a set procedure. Knows when to escalate and when to decide. (be accountable) Conveys complex technical information persuasively to non-technical audiences, adapting style to the listener and developing recommendations that stakeholders can act on. (communicate clearly) Provides work direction, mentoring and design review to less experienced colleagues without formal line management authority, giving feedback that raises the standard of the teams output. (trust each other) Builds working relationships beyond the immediate team, advising colleagues across functions and locations and negotiating priorities where demand competes. (trust each other) Owns quality and governance standards for their own area, holds others to them, and raises problems early rather than working around them. (be accountable) Keeps pace with the modern data stack and the Fabric roadmap, evaluating new capabilities on their merits and championing those that earn their place. (be fast) Works comfortably with ambiguity on new engineering assignments, defining the approach where no precedent exists and documenting it so others can follow. (be fast)

description:
Position Summary... What youll do... About Team GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmarts AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 
 What Youll Do - Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale. - Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role. - Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code. - Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDFs broader platform codebase. - Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation. - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on. - Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline. - Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains. - As a Principal engineer, set technical direction and best practices across multiple teams and the broader GDF platform without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDFs broader data engineering standards. - Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 
 What Youll Bring - Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. - Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. - Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - including batch and streaming processing, and large-scale data transformation. - Strong data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with lakehouse architectures (e.g., Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks). - not just conceptual awareness. - Working literacy in platform engineering: microservices, API design, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, CI/CD, and cloud-native practices - enough to flex into platform/software engineering work confidently. - Strong distributed systems fundamentals: event-driven patterns, service contracts, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance at scale - paired with strong system design, domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, and demonstrated ability to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost when owning production code. - Strong software engineering craftsmanship: testing strategy, code review standards, design patterns, and system design for high-throughput data systems. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous data/business problems into clear technical execution plans, particularly across a newly formed platform organization without fully established process. - Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a 0-to-1 environment.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer SRE & Application Development 
 About the Role We are looking for a highly hands-on Platform Engineer who can move seamlessly between SRE/platform responsibilities and production application development . This is a dual-focus engineering role. You will own systems end-to-end from application code and infrastructure through deployment, observability, troubleshooting, and production operations. GCP and AWS experience are mandatory. 
 What You'll Do Own production reliability, availability, observability, incident response, and root-cause resolution across GCP and AWS. Build, operate, and improve Kubernetes/GKE environments, Terraform infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. Design, develop, debug, and maintain production applications, APIs, backend services, and automation using Python, Go, or similar backend languages. Operate and optimize distributed data workloads using BigQuery, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, and related services. Troubleshoot complex issues across application, infrastructure, networking, and data layers. Reduce operational toil through automation and improve platform resilience, scalability, performance, observability, and cloud efficiency. Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully for coding, debugging, prototyping, automation, and technical problem solving while validating security, quality, and production readiness. 
 Must-Have Skills 3-6 years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Backend Engineering, or Cloud Engineering. Strong production experience with both GCP and AWS . Strong application development and debugging skills in Python, Go, or another modern backend language . Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform/IaC, CI/CD , and cloud-native production systems. Ability to independently troubleshoot distributed systems across application, infrastructure, networking, and data layers. Strong Linux, monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-management experience. 
 Preferred Skills GCP Associate or Professional certification. Deep experience with GKE and production Kubernetes operations. Experience with BigQuery, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Airflow/Cloud Composer, and high-throughput data platforms. Experience building highly available and fault-tolerant distributed systems. Experience with modern AI-assisted engineering tools for development, debugging, automation, and technical problem solving. 
 What Success Looks Like Owns production systems end-to-end and drives issues through permanent resolution. Contributes meaningful production code, not just infrastructure changes. Automates repetitive operational work and reduces incident frequency and recovery time. Improves reliability, scalability, observability, cloud efficiency, and engineering velocity. Leaves systems easier to operate through better design, tooling, documentation, and knowledge sharing. 
 This Role Is Not A monitoring-only or support-only SRE role. A traditional infrastructure administrator position. A DevOps role focused only on CI/CD. An application developer role disconnected from production operations. A coordination-focused role with limited hands-on engineering. 
 If you enjoy solving complex production problems, writing real application code, automating infrastructure, and owning systems end-to-end, we'd like to hear from you.

 Meet the Team Our team is a dynamic and collaborative group united by a shared passion for innovation and a commitment to excellence. We foster a culture of open communication, mutual respect, and continuous learning, where every voice is valued and encouraged to contribute. We offer a stimulating environment where you can grow your career, make a real impact, and be part of something truly meaningful. 
 
 Your Impact 
 The Cisco Supply Chain Product Operations team is looking for a motivated and skilled Product Lifecycle New Product Project Manager to drive the successful introduction of new products to market. You will lead cross-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle, ensuring critical milestones are achieved, risks are proactively mitigated, and rigorous quality standards are upheld. This is a unique opportunity to shape product strategy and drive operational excellence across Cisco s global landscape. Responsibilities include: End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead and manage the full project lifecycle for New Product Introductions (NPI), from initial concept through to launch and post-launch support. Cross-Functional Leadership: Facilitate seamless collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Sales teams. Strategic Planning: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in close partnership with senior leadership and key stakeholders. Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, track, and resolve project risks and issues to ensure timely and successful delivery. Performance Tracking: Monitor project performance, manage budget allocations, and provide consistent status updates to stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Drive process enhancements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of our product lifecycle management frameworks. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor s degree in engineering, business, or a related field. 5-10 years of experience in project management, with a focus on product development or product lifecycle management. Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and complex projects without direct authority within a fast-paced environment. Advanced understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) methodologies and tools. Outstanding communication, negotiation, and customer management skills.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities.  What Youll Bring - Genuinely hands-on coding: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. - Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward. -  Responsibilities

description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world s most important health challenges. Additionally, the Clinical Data Analyst I offers administrative and technical support to internal teams and maintains a strong understanding of Labcorps databases. 
 Analyze and resolve client-reported data discrepancies, updating databases as required and in compliance with applicable GCP guidelines. Lead cross-functional communications to drive discrepancy resolution through to completion. Perform data revisions ranging from basic to highly complex, adhering to established data revision and data cleaning processes. Provide clear responses to client inquiries and recommend alternative solutions when requests are not feasible. Engage internal stake holders in decision-making processes to ensure business needs are understood and addressed. Escalate risks or issues that may impact timely discrepancy resolution and client deliverables. Manage workload effectively to meet established deadlines and service expectations. Collaborate within a global, team-oriented environment with a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence. Ensure timely compliance with management communications, procedures, and organizational standards. Document service failures and conduct investigations as required. Support additional projects and responsibilities as assigned by management. Manage and monitor shared mailboxes to ensure timely query loading Support Client Leads in managing client needs and operational priorities. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s degree in science or related field. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of professional experience. Strong understanding of data revision/reconciliation processes and lab/clinical data management. title: Lead Analyst, Master Data Management (MDM)
description:
The Lead MDM Analyst supports the analysis, validation, and documentation activities required to ensure that data flowing from MDM 360 (Customer 360 / Reference 360) into downstream systems is accurate, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an analyst not a developer — role. Rather than building pipelines or writing production code, the Junior MDM Analyst interprets data flows, documents findings, validates data quality, supports requirements gathering, and assists with UAT and reconciliation reviews across consumption and reporting workstreams. This role is an excellent entry point into MDM programme delivery, offering exposure to: MDM 360 APIs / Batch Snowflake Financial Reporting UI Consumption Key Responsibilities 1. MDM Data Understanding & Documentation Develop a working understanding of MDM golden record structures and how data flows from MDM 360 to downstream systems Document data flows, field mappings, and transformation logic under the guidance of the P4 Analyst or BA Lead Maintain and update data mapping registers, attribute lists, and business rule logs as requirements evolve Assist in maintaining the MDM data dictionary — recording field definitions, data types, and ownership Note and escalate data anomalies or gaps in documentation identified during analysis activities 2. Data Validation & Quality Checking Supporting validation across the consumption data flow — from MDM through to reporting: Run and review data validation checks across: MDM golden records vs. API payload outputs Batch pipeline outputs vs. expected source data Snowflake consumption layer vs. MDM source records UI-displayed data vs. MDM and Snowflake outputs Use SQL (with guidance) to query datasets, identify discrepancies, and validate attribute-level accuracy Apply data quality checks across key dimensions — completeness, accuracy, consistency — and document outcomes Log and track data quality issues in agreed tooling (e.g. JIRA, SharePoint, Excel trackers) Escalate unresolved or high-impact data discrepancies to the P4 Analyst or BA Lead promptly 3. Downstream Reporting & Financial Data Support Support validation of MDM data used in financial and regulatory reporting layers Assist in reconciliation activities between: MDM golden records and Snowflake reporting datasets Reporting outputs and expected business values for key financial attributes and hierarchies Document reconciliation results clearly — noting matched records, mismatches, and volumes Assist in investigating data breaks and reporting discrepancies by gathering relevant data and preparing findings for P4 review Track and follow up on outstanding reconciliation items through to resolution 4. Requirements Support & Analysis Documentation Supporting the P4 BA in translating business needs into clear, documented requirements: Attend requirements workshops, take structured notes, and circulate agreed actions and decisions Assist in drafting user stories, acceptance criteria, and data mapping specifications under senior guidance Review and cross-check requirements documents for completeness, consistency, and alignment with MDM data standards Maintain up-to-date requirements logs and traceability matrices for the consumption workstream Raise questions and clarification points with the P4 Analyst when requirements are unclear or ambiguous 5. API & Batch Pipeline Validation Support From an analysis — not development — standpoint: Review API payload structures (JSON) and validate that field mappings match agreed data specifications Use API testing tools (Postman, Swagger) under guidance to inspect responses and document findings Monitor batch job outcomes and validate data completeness and successful execution against expected results Log pipeline validation findings and assist in drafting defect descriptions for technical teams Track open pipeline issues through to resolution, providing status updates to the P4 lead 6. UAT Support & Defect Tracking Support UAT activities across API, batch, Snowflake, and reporting validation scenarios Execute test cases defined by the P4 Analyst or BA Lead — validate data movement accuracy and business rule adherence Log defects clearly and completely in agreed defect tracking tools — including steps to reproduce, observed vs. expected results, and data evidence Track defects through to resolution and retest fixes as required Assist in preparing UAT summary notes and test evidence for sign-off activities Required Skills & Experience Analytical Skills Strong attention to description:
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe, or helping find cures for cancer. 
 Description: Join our collaborative team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Technical Lead, Cell analysis where you will provide world-class scientific expertise and support to our customers in Flow Cytometry and Cell sorting experiments in Basic cell culture, advanced cell culture workflows including organoid, stem cell and primary immune cell modification and culture . As a Technical Lead, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor helping customers optimize their use of our innovative technologies across advanced cell analysis solutions and supporting their journey in translational clinical research. In this role, you ll deliver high-quality pre-sales and post-sales support through scientific seminars, product demonstrations, hands-on training, troubleshooting assistance and technical consultation on relevant applications. You will also play a key role in driving end-to-end execution of our workflows with our collaborators. Working closely with sales teams and cross-functional partners, you ll help customers achieve significant discoveries while building long-term relationships that drive business success. This role offers opportunities for professional growth and development within an organization committed to enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. 
 Responsibilities Portfolio Support - Provide independent on-site pre-sales demos and post-sales product and scientific workflow trainings. - Deliver product-and workflow- specific consultations focused on advanced cell analysis processes utilizing Thermo Fisher Scientific s leading solutions such as Attune Family Benchtops Bigfoot. - Provide panel design support handholding the customers for assay optimization. - Prepare and present seminars to a wide array of audiences. - Develop and lead hands-on workshops, demos, and internal and external trainings. - Provide market sensing mechanism, identifying new opportunities and trends, and highlighting gaps in current portfolio. - Work with internal teams to develop and update workflow applications and education content for customer training in the form of videos, seminars, training manuals etc. - Connect with the global and regional Technical Sales teams and share insights to new applications. - Support marketing and business development functions in developing new content around data generated in-house or with collaborators. - Work with the regional and local scientists to lead, facilitate and follow through with the implementation of new projects with collaborators. 
 Experience: - Required: PhD in Biology, Cell Biology, or related field. - At least 5 years of commercial 5 years of laboratory experience. Research experience in cell biology and/or immunology may be considered in lieu of commercial experience. - Experience with data analysis, experimental design, process development and technical troubleshooting. - Prior practical experiences in research clinical immunoassay applications would be an advantage. - Must possess strong understanding of customer challenges associated with transition to clinical workflows, and the relevant industry standards and best practices. 
 Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: - Excellent oral and written communication skills are required. - Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence for understanding customer needs. - Must excel in a client-facing role and be comfortable with speaking publicly to technical audiences. - Able to work with a multi-disciplinary matrixed group that includes commercial representatives, RD scientists, product management and marketing development representatives. - Demonstrate judgment, tact and subtlety in handling internal and external members, and confidential and proprietary information. - Ability to travel 50% of the time.

title: Senior Billing & Collections Specialist
description:
Summary of the Role 
As a Sr. B2B Collections Specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for managing and safeguarding the companys receivables. You will collaborate directly with senior leadership to shape and optimize our collections strategies, focusing on late collections bucket. Your expertise in stakeholder management will be critical to fostering strong internal and external relationships, ensuring timely payment, and maintaining the financial health of our legal tech platform.

 What you will do: 

 Strategic Collections & Stakeholder Management 
 Serve as the subject matter expert and main liaison for high-value clients and senior internal stakeholders to address complex billing and payment issues.
 Develop and maintain strategic relationships with customers, internal teams (Finance, Sales, Customer Success), and external partners to ensure a smooth and efficient collections process.
 Regularly communicate key collections metrics and insights to senior leadership, providing recommendations to optimize cash flow.
 Advanced Payment Reminders & Negotiations 
 Oversee and refine the process of proactive communication with customers via phone, email, and other channels to remind them of outstanding balances.
 Lead high-level negotiations and handle escalated billing disputes or payment delays with tact and diplomacy.

 Leadership & Mentorship 
 Guide and mentor junior Accounts Receivable team members, providing training on effective collections strategies, customer engagement, and conflict resolution.
 Collaborate with management to set team goals and ensure the AR function operates at peak efficiency.
 Process Optimization & Reporting 
 Design, implement, and refine systematic follow-up schedules and tools to enhance AR outcomes.
 Utilize data-driven insights to evaluate the effectiveness of collections processes and to forecast receivables.
 Generate and present regular reports, dashboards, and action plans to senior leadership, ensuring transparency in collections performance and related financial metrics.
 Compliance & Risk Management 
 Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting principles, industry regulations, and legal guidelines related to billing and collections.
 Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with overdue accounts, working with legal counsel or external agencies when necessary.
 
 Requirements: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification (e.g., CPA, CMA) is a plus.
 5+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable or collections in a B2B environment with focus on late collections.
 Demonstrated success in managing high-level, complex collections issues and working with senior leadership.
 Proficiency in Collections KPI, effectiveness and conversion metrics.
 Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting and data analysis.
 Exceptional communication and negotiation abilities, with experience handling high-value clients or escalated disputes.
 Proven leadership, mentoring, and project management skills.
 Ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strict attention to detail.
 Key Attributes for Success 
 Strategic Mindset : Aptitude for understanding broader business objectives and aligning AR processes accordingly.

Job Summary Sr Manager- Supply Chain Performance Position Summary The Senior Engineer I - Supply Chain Performance is responsible for driving end-to-end supply chain excellence through performance management, planning optimization, inventory control, operational analytics, continuous improvement, and cross-functional coordination. The role ensures alignment between customer demand, production capabilities, material availability, and business objectives while leading initiatives that improve service, cost, inventory, and productivity performance. This position serves as a key catalyst for operational excellence by deploying digital tools, performance governance, and continuous improvement methodologies across the plant and supply chain network. Responsibilities Supply Chain Performance Management Establish and monitor supply chain KPIs including OTD, OTDC, Service Level, Inventory Turns, DOH, Forecast Accuracy, Backlog, and Lead Time. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify improvement opportunities. Develop dashboards and digital reporting systems to support data-driven decision making. Drive visibility of risks, bottlenecks, and recovery plans across the supply chain. Planning & Execution Excellence Support SIOP/SPIOP processes to ensure alignment between demand and supply. Analyze demand trends, capacity constraints, and inventory implications. Coordinate closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, and Customer Care teams. Ensure execution of production and material plans to meet customer commitments. Inventory & Working Capital Optimization Drive inventory reduction initiatives while protecting customer service levels. Monitor slow-moving, excess, obsolete, and non-moving inventory. Improve inventory accuracy and warehouse performance. Support working capital improvement objectives. Continuous Improvement & Digitalization Lead Lean Supply Chain and Continuous Improvement projects. Apply problem-solving methodologies such as Kaizen, DMAIC, PDCA, and Root Cause Analysis. Deploy digital tools, automation, Power BI dashboards, and analytics solutions. Standardize reporting and governance processes across functions. Cross-Functional Leadership Facilitate collaboration among Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and Engineering teams. Lead performance review meetings and action-tracking mechanisms. Support strategic projects including localization, capacity expansion, business continuity, and network optimization. Customer Service & Operational Excellence Improve customer service performance through proactive risk management. Ensure timely escalation and resolution of supply chain issues. Drive actions to improve responsiveness, flexibility, and operational reliability. Support customer satisfaction and business growth objectives. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Delivery (OTD) On-Time Delivery to Customer (OTDC) Service Level Inventory Turns Days of Inventory (DOI) Forecast Accuracy Backlog Reduction Material Availability Working Capital Productivity Savings Supply Chain Cost Continuous Improvement Savings Qualifications Education Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or related discipline. MBA / APICS / Lean Six Sigma certification preferred. Experience 8-12 years of experience in Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Industrial Engineering, or Continuous Improvement. Experience in manufacturing environments such as Electrical Distribution, Switchgear, Industrial Automation, or related industries preferred. Technical Competencies Supply Chain Planning SIOP / Integrated Business Planning Inventory Management Demand & Capacity Planning Performance Analytics Power BI / Tableau SAP / ERP Systems Lean Manufacturing Project Management Leadership Competencies Influencing without Authority Stakeholder Management Strategic Thinking Problem Solving Change Management Results Orientation Cross-Functional Collaboration Communication & Presentation Skills

title: Senior Data Scientist  (Third-Party Data Analytics & Evaluation)
description:

We partner with leading global companies to deliver data-driven solutions that drive measurable business impact. Role Overview We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong analytical skills and experience working with third-party data, data brokers, audience data, and data quality assessment, preferably within the AdTech or MarTech ecosystem. In this role, you will evaluate external data providers, independently validate their data quality and performance claims, and transform validated datasets into standardized, analytics-ready features for household intelligence and downstream machine learning applications. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and proficient in Python and SQL for data analysis and validation. Experience with audience measurement, identity resolution, consumer data, advertising data, or marketing data platforms will be highly valuable. Key Responsibilities Third-Party Data Evaluation & Quality Assessment Evaluate third-party data providers, data brokers, audience datasets, panel data, and video/viewership data using real-world samples. Independently validate vendor-reported match rates, data coverage, label accuracy, and other data quality metrics. Analyze data completeness, duplication, bot activity, overlap, geographic distribution, and consistency across datasets. Develop and execute repeatable methodologies to assess vendor data quality and identify gaps between claimed and observed performance. Document findings, supporting evidence, and recommendations using standardized data quality scorecards. Data Analytics & Statistical Validation Perform exploratory data analysis and statistical assessments to understand dataset characteristics, reliability, and usability. Analyze audience and household-level data distributions, including geographic segmentation such as Designated Market Areas (DMAs). Assess data overlap, sample representativeness, anomalies, and potential sources of bias. Define validation rules, quality thresholds, and measurable criteria for accepting or rejecting third-party datasets. Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for technical and business stakeholders. Data Mapping & Feature Engineering Map vendor-specific schemas, data dictionaries, and attributes to a common data taxonomy. Standardize and transform validated data into structured, reusable features for household intelligence and audience analytics. Contribute feature definitions, validation rules, and quality checks for a shared feature store supporting household-level analytics and machine learning. Collaborate with Data Engineers to define validated schemas, transformation requirements, and data pipeline specifications. Ensure that data is documented, traceable, reproducible, and suitable for downstream analytical and ML applications. Identity Resolution, Privacy & Compliance Evaluate data matching methodologies, including deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution techniques. Work with identity-related concepts such as hashed PII, mobile advertising IDs (MAIDs), hashed emails (HEMs), household IDs, and audience identifiers. Assess identity match quality, duplication, household association, and potential inconsistencies across data sources. Identify potential privacy, consent, data provenance, and permitted-use concerns in third-party datasets, escalating issues to the relevant legal or compliance teams. Maintain clear documentation of data sources, assumptions, validation methods, and limitations. Stakeholder Collaboration & Reporting Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to operationalize validated datasets. Present quantitative findings and vendor assessments in a clear, concise, and business-friendly manner. Provide evidence-based recommendations on vendor data suitability, quality risks, and potential use cases. Support continuous improvement of data evaluation methodologies, quality standards, and analytical processes. Required Experience & Skills 48 years of experience in data science, data analytics, data quality analysis, or a related quantitative role. Strong experience analyzing third-party datasets, data broker data, audience data, consumer data, panel data, or other externally sourced datasets. Exposure to the AdTech or MarTech ecosystem , including audience data, advertising measurement, marketing analytics, identity resolution, or customer data platforms. Strong analytical and statistical skills, with experience in data profiling, match-rate analysis, deduplication, overlap analysis, and distributional assessment. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and manipulation, particularly using pandas and NumPy; scikit-learn or equivalent libraries are beneficial. Strong SQL skills for data extraction, joining, aggregation, reconciliation, and validation across large datasets. Experience evaluating data dictionaries, schemas, source provenance, completeness, consistency, and reliability. Understanding of deterministic versus probabilistic matching and familiarity with hashed PII, MAIDs, HEMs, and household-level identifiers. Working knowledge of feature engineering and preparing structured datasets for downstream analytics or machine learning. Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders. title: Security Analyst
description:
About the Opportunity: 
 Role: Security Analyst Location: Gurgaon 
 About the function: At MakeMyTrip (MMT), technology is at the heart of everything we do. As a leading player in the travel industry, we leverage cutting-edge solutions like AI, machine learning, and cloud infrastructure to create seamless and innovative travel experiences. We prioritize a tech-first mindset, where our engineering teams lead the charge in transforming the way people travel. 
 Our culture encourages collaboration, creativity, and thought leadership, empowering engineers to challenge the status quo and develop impactful, game-changing solutions. At MMT, you'll work with the latest technologies, continually push boundaries, and have the chance to shape the future of travel. 
 Join us and become part of a forward-thinking, tech-driven organization that thrives on innovation and continuous learning. 
 About the Role: We are looking for a Security Analyst to join the MakeMyTrip Cybersecurity team and strengthen MMTs defense against evolving cyber threats. This role involves monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security incidents while enhancing our security framework. The ideal candidate should have 4-6 years of experience in Security Operations, with a strong focus on Endpoint Security and network security controls. Hands-on experience with security tools in these areas is essential. Scripting knowledge is preferable, along with a proactive learning attitude, strong problem-solving skills, and a can-do mindset. 
 What will you be doing: Monitor and analyse security events across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments. Implement and manage security controls using various security technologies. Ensure strong endpoint protection and respond to threats, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activities. Manage and enhance email security to prevent phishing, malware, and other emailbased threats. Work on Zero Trust security principles to enhance access control and identity security. Assist in security incident detection, response, and remediation efforts. Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and compliance documentation. Collaborate with IT and security teams to strengthen the overall security posture. Automate security processes using Python, PowerShell, or Bash. Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies. 
 Qualification Experience: 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, focusing on endpoint security, network security, and cloud security. Hands-on experience with security tools in areas such as: Endpoint Security: EDR, XDR, Incident Response, malware analysis, threat hunting. Network Security: NAC, firewalls, IDS/IPS, network segmentation, Zero Trust access. Cloud Web Security: SSE, CASB, Secure Web Gateway, DLP, cloud security posture management Email Security: Email analysis, expertise in email authentication protocols, knowledge of modern email-based cyber threats, and integration of threat intelligence Strong understanding of Zero Trust security models and implementation. Knowledge of security best practices, frameworks, and compliance standards (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, etc.). Experience in security incident investigation, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management. Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell, Bash) is a plus. Familiarity with SIEM tools and log analysis for threat detection. Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive learning attitude. Strong communication and documentation skills to convey security insights effectively.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards, along with practical experience in openEHR template/archetype design, healthcare data mapping, terminology mapping, and interface validation. This role requires someone who can contribute not only as an individual contributor but also support solutioning, technical design, team guidance, and stakeholder discussions. The candidate should be able to work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, validate, and improve scalable healthcare interoperability solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of healthcare interoperability solutions and platforms. Work with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards to design and implement healthcare data exchange workflows. Design, review, and maintain openEHR templates, archetypes, and clinical data models based on clinical and business requirements. Perform healthcare data mapping, transformation, and validation across different standards and source systems. Support terminology and concept mapping activities, including mapping of clinical concepts, codes, and value sets. Conduct interface testing, API testing, payload validation, and compliance checks against agreed specifications and standards. Participate in and drive solutioning, technical design, and architecture discussions for interoperability use cases. Help define data flow, transformation logic, integration approach, and validation strategy for healthcare interfaces. Collaborate with technical teams, business teams, clinical stakeholders, and external partners to clarify requirements and ensure correct implementation. Lead, guide, and mentor team members on interoperability standards, mapping logic, template design, and implementation approach. Review deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with healthcare interoperability standards. Track and report project progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership. Stay updated with evolving healthcare interoperability standards, implementation guides, and industry best practices. Qualifications 3-5 years of experience in the healthcare IT domain, with a strong focus on healthcare interoperability. Hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards. Strong experience in healthcare data modelling, data transformation, mappings, and integration workflows. Practical experience in designing and maintaining openEHR templates and archetypes. Experience in mapping healthcare data between different formats, systems, and standards. Experience in testing and validating healthcare interfaces, APIs, messages, and payloads. Experience in participating in or driving technical solutioning, design discussions, and implementation planning. Experience in guiding team members and reviewing technical deliverables. Familiarity with databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar relational databases. Basic programming or scripting knowledge is preferred; Java knowledge is an added advantage. Educational background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field. Skills and Competencies Strong understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and clinical data exchange. Good understanding of openEHR modelling, template design, archetypes, and clinical data structures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand clinical/business requirements and translate them into technical designs and mappings. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work with cross-functional and distributed teams. Ability to guide team members and provide technical direction. Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, correctness, and compliance. Good documentation, reporting, and presentation skills. Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and gaps in requirements or implementation. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field. Certification in HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR, openEHR, or healthcare interoperability standards is good to have but not mandatory. Experience with integration engines or healthcare integration tools such as Mirth Connect, NiFi, or similar tools is an added advantage. Experience with healthcare terminology standards such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD, or concept/value set mapping is an added advantage. Experience working on CDR, EHR, EMR, data integration, or healthcare data platform implementations is preferred.

This role will be responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving world-class safety management systems that support a safe, healthy, and compliant work environment. The Director will partner closely with Facilities, Manufacturing, Engineering, Construction, Global EHS, and external regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Micron EHS standards, and industry best practices while fostering a strong safety-first culture across the organization. Key Responsibilities Safety Leadership & Strategy Lead and manage site Safety and Occupational Health programs. Champion a proactive safety culture through leadership engagement, coaching, and employee involvement. Establish annual safety goals, KPIs, and improvement plans aligned with site and corporate objectives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world-class EHS performance. Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian statutory requirements, including Factories Act, Gujarat Factory Rules, and other EHS regulations. Maintain compliance with Micron Corporate EHS requirements and industry standards. Interface with government agencies, regulatory authorities, auditors, and emergency responders. Ensure contractors and vendors comply with site safety requirements. Partner with Facilities and Construction teams to review safety requirements during project planning, installation, commissioning, and operational phases. Emergency Preparedness Develop and maintain emergency response plans and procedures. Coordinate drills for fire, chemical releases, medical emergencies, and other site-specific scenarios. Collaborate with internal emergency response teams and external agencies. Safety Systems & Governance Manage EHS committees and governance forums. Support and maintain EHS management systems aligned with ISO requirements. Prepare management reports, dashboards, and safety performance reviews. Training & Awareness Develop and deploy site-wide safety training programs. Conduct awareness campaigns and leadership engagement activities. Ensure all employees, contractors, and visitors receive appropriate safety orientation and training. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline. Advanced qualification in Industrial Safety, Safety Engineering, or EH&S preferred. Experience 20+ years of progressive EHS/Safety experience. Minimum 5 years in a leadership role within semiconductor, manufacturing, chemical, electronics, or high-tech industries. Experience supporting greenfield or large-scale manufacturing operations is highly desirable. Certifications (Preferred) Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety. Certified Safety Professional (CSP), NEBOSH, or equivalent. Knowledge of Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) standards. Key Competencies Strategic Safety Leadership Regulatory Compliance Management Risk Assessment & Hazard Analysis Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis Emergency Response & Crisis Management Stakeholder Management Leveraging Artificial Intelligence & Applying Artificial Intelligence

description:
Job Summary As part of our EY ER - Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you will consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Senior Consultant (Validation/Tester Veeva) to lead validation, testing activities and compliance across various Veeva modules, regulated and business critical computerized systems for global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence. Your Key Responsibilities Define CSA/CSV strategy in collaboration with Governance & Vaidation Lead and risk-based validation approach for the Veeva Vault platform, balancing modern CSA principles (critical thinking, risk-based test coverage) with CSV rigor where required for specific vaults/regulatory contexts. Perform risk assessments on platform changes (configuration, integration, releases) to determine appropriate validation rigor and evidence requirements per change. Define validation/testing evidence requirements in partnership with the QA Engineer role ensuring test coverage decisions are risk-justified and audit-defensible. Review and approve validation deliverables (validation plans, risk assessments, test evidence, validation summary reports) before closure. Ensure platform changes comply with applicable regulations (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5) and internal Computerized System Validation policies. Provide compliance guidance to internal Leads and vendor team members on how CSA principles apply to specific configuration/integration scenarios. Support internal/external audits and health authority inspections act as the platform's validation SME during inspection readiness and response. Partner with QA/Change Management to ensure Change Control records carry appropriate validation justification and evidence. Stay current on evolving CSA guidance (e.g., FDA's CSA draft guidance) and industry practice, advising the CoE on policy updates. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years in CSV within the pharmaceutical, life sciences or consulting organizations. Comfortable working with distributed teams across India, Prague, and US time zones. Strong influencing skills to drive practice change (CSV CSA) across a delivery team that includes multiple other vendor roles. Must-Have Skills & Attributes 5+ years of experience in Computer System Validation, with demonstrated leadership transitioning teams from traditional CSV to CSA practices. Deep knowledge of GAMP 5 (2nd edition), FDA CSA guidance, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11. Experience defining risk-based testing/validation strategies that reduce documentation/testing burden without compromising compliance. Experience validating cloud/SaaS platforms (Veeva Vault experience strongly preferred) in a GxP environment. Experience supporting regulatory inspections/audits as a validation SME. Strong stakeholder influencing skills this role must drive adoption of CSA thinking across delivery teams (Configuration, Integration, QA) who may default to legacy CSV habits. Experience partnering with QA/Test Automation teams to align risk assessments with automated test coverage decisions. Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes Prior experience specifically validating Veeva Vault implementations (any vault Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical, CRM). Experience building or updating an organization's CSA policy/SOP framework. Experience with Veeva Vault QMS/QualityDocs as the vehicle for validation documentation. ISPE GAMP 5 training/certification Preferred Certifications Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA) Information Security or Risk Management certifications. Any Veeva Quality certification. What we look for A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills. An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. title: Founding Mechanical Engineer
description:
Founding Mechanical Engineer 
 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 Experience: 3-6 years preferred
 Company: DullWorks Automation 

 About the Role This is an opportunity to take ownership of mechanical product development, from the initial concept and 3D CAD modelling to manufacturing, assembly and physical testing. We are not looking for someone who only creates CAD models or renders. We want an engineer who understands how real machines are designed, manufactured, assembled, tested and improved. You will work closely with the founding team to develop mechanical systems, robotic mechanisms and automation equipment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Mechanical Design and 3D Modelling Design detailed 3D parts, assemblies and mechanical systems using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Creo or equivalent CAD software. Develop mechanisms, frames, brackets, mounts, shafts, enclosures and moving assemblies for robotic and automation equipment. Select suitable motors, gearboxes, bearings, linear guides, belts, pulleys, fasteners and other mechanical components. Design for strength, rigidity, maintainability, weight, cost and ease of assembly. 
 2. Manufacturing and Design for Assembly Convert CAD designs into production-ready 2D engineering drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances and fits. Prepare bills of materials (BOMs), assembly drawings and manufacturing documentation. Apply design-for-manufacturing (DFM) and design-for-assembly (DFA) principles. Work with CNC machining, laser cutting, sheet-metal fabrication, welding, 3D printing and other manufacturing processes as appropriate. Coordinate with fabrication vendors to ensure components can be manufactured accurately and cost-effectively. 
 3. Prototyping and Physical Assembly Build and assemble functional mechanical prototypes. Perform fit checks, alignment checks, mechanical testing and troubleshooting. Identify interference, tolerance, vibration, stiffness and reliability issues. Iterate on designs based on real-world test results rather than relying solely on CAD simulations. 
 4. Robotics and Automation Development Develop mechanical systems for robotic vehicles, material handling, conveyors, automated machines and robotic end-effectors. Integrate mechanical assemblies with motors, actuators, sensors and electronics. Collaborate with the software and electronics team to ensure complete system integration. Help transform early concepts into reliable, manufacturable products. 
 5. Ownership and Collaboration Take responsibility for mechanical engineering tasks from concept to prototype validation. Maintain CAD files, drawings, BOMs, component specifications and revision histories. Research components and manufacturing methods to optimise cost and performance. Contribute ideas, challenge assumptions and help establish the startup's engineering processes. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Strong proficiency in at least one parametric CAD tool such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Creo or Autodesk Inventor. Practical understanding of mechanical components, materials, fits, tolerances, fasteners and mechanisms. Experience preparing manufacturing drawings and BOMs. Understanding of manufacturing processes and design for manufacturing and assembly. Demonstrated hands-on experience with physical prototypes, mechanical assemblies or manufactured products. Ability to identify practical engineering problems and develop cost-effective solutions. A strong sense of ownership, resourcefulness and willingness to work in a fast-moving startup environment. 
 Good to Have Experience in robotics, AGVs/AMRs, RGVs, warehouse automation, ASRS, conveyors or industrial automation. Experience designing robotic mechanisms, grippers, fixtures or automated material handling systems. Familiarity with motors, gearboxes, linear motion systems and drive mechanisms. Experience working directly with machine shops and fabrication vendors. Basic understanding of FEA, mechanical simulation and tolerance stack-up analysis. Experience taking a product from prototype to a repeatable manufacturing process. 

 Why Join Us? 
 Early-team ownership: Contribute directly to the product and engineering decisions that shape the company. End-to-end product development: Work on real machines, not only CAD models or documentation. Direct founder collaboration: Have a voice in technical decisions, priorities and product direction. Meaningful responsibility: Build the mechanical engineering function and its design and manufacturing processes. Early-employee growth opportunity: Grow with the company as the product, team and business develop. 
 Compensation and Engagement Structure 
 We are an early-stage startup with limited cash resources. We cannot currently offer a conventional fixed monthly salary for this opportunity. This position is intended for someone interested in a genuine founding-team, subject to an agreed and documented structure. Please note that, ESOP participation and other benefits are not implied unless specifically agreed in writing. Any future cash compensation will depend on the company's funding, revenue and financial position. A future salary increase is not guaranteed unless formally agreed. Please review the current arrangement carefully before applying. 

 How to Apply 
 Please share your resume and, wherever possible, a portfolio of mechanical designs, CAD assemblies, manufacturing drawings or physical prototypes you have personally worked on. We are especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate the complete journey from 3D modelling to manufacturing, assembly and testing. 
 PS: Your ability to build a working machine matters more to us than how impressive a CAD rendering looks.

Key Skills: CAD,Manufacturing,Prototyping,Assembly,Mechanical Design,CNC,DFM,3D Modeling

In this senior, escalated technical role, you will act as the highest level of internal technical escalation for operating system incidents, complex systems engineering, system migrations, and operational resilience across mission-critical enterprise IBM Z environments. You will lead complex problem resolution, drive major operating system upgrades — including migrations from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2 — oversee JES3 spool/batch subsystems, manage advanced MVS console alerting, and ensure robust disaster recovery and storage redundancy utilizing CSM (Copy Services Manager). Demonstrated background supporting high-volume, 24x7 mission-critical financial, enterprise, or government mainframe operations. Comprehensive mastery of z/OS architecture and administration, including z/OS 3.1 and release readiness for z/OS 3.2. Advanced SMP/E experience (RECEIVE, APPLY, ACCEPT, RESTORE, SMPPTS, and CSI management). Hands-on expertise in JES3 environments (JES3plex, spool management, initialization decks, Global/Local operations). Knowledge of Parallel Sysplex concepts: Sysplex Timers (STP), Coupling Facility (CF) structures, and CDS management. Experience with report and log archiving suites, specifically CA View and Flasher. Strong scripting and automation skills: REXX, CLIST, and JCL mastery. Security administration experience: RACF or ACF2 (profiles, certificates, class administration, and audit remediation). Willingness to work the 5:30 PM–2:30 AM IST shift, including scheduled weekend and off-hours coverage during planned OS migrations, maintenance windows, and disaster recovery exercises.  We are looking for a System Administrator who will lead the day-to-day administration, optimization, and automation of our enterprise virtualization platforms, datacenter infrastructure, and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, and disaster readiness of mission-critical workloads, and will support large-scale datacenter projects for government and enterprise customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage and maintain enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), and Nutanix AHV clusters (Prism Central/Element). Configure and tune vSphere HA, DRS, vMotion, vSAN, and Distributed Switches, and monitor cluster and host health using VMware Aria Operations. Design, implement, and test replication, failover clustering, and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., VMware SRM) for mission-critical workloads. Administer hybrid cloud environments on Google Cloud Platform and AWS, including landing zones, IAM policies, and network architecture. Administer Windows Server and Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux) environments for performance, security, and uptime. Manage Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and Group Policy Objects, including user and resource provisioning. Plan and execute patching of servers, ESXi hosts, and workstations using WSUS, ensuring compliance with organizational policies. Execute VM migrations across platforms (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Proxmox VE) using tools such as Nutanix Move. Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment. Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker. Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers). Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams.

Ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in system administration, virtualization, and datacenter management. Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis.
